english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a physical calendar showing dates.

examples.english: I look at the calendar every morning to see what date it is.
examples.traditional: 我每日朝早都會睇日曆，睇吓今日係幾號。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 wui5 tai2 jat6 lik6 tai2 haa5 gam1 jat6 hai6 gei2 hou6
